market_context: The cooler October PPI reading of 0.3% versus 0.4% expected failed to sustain the overnight equity bid because annual wholesale inflation remained hot at 6.5%; by midday SPY had reversed its gap-up while the 10-year Treasury yield reached 5.13% and VIX rose 6.79% (asleepace.com). AI and semiconductor shares are the principal drag following Jensen Huang's resignation, with SOXX and SMH down approximately 5.2% and 4.4%, while Dow/value shares are outperforming (finance.yahoo.com).

predictions.reasoning: SPY has surrendered the entire gap above Thursday's $757.12 close and remains below the $755 put wall and $761.77 gamma flip in a negative-gamma setup ([theadaptivetrader.substack.com). The intraday structure is bearish below $757.12, with a close under $750.36 exposing lower support; rising yields favor another dip into the close (tradingview.com).

Semiconductor confirmation is exceptionally weak: SOXX was down 5.16%, SMH 4.40%, and SOXQ 4.98% around midday (finance.yahoo.com). With QQQ well below the premarket $690 pivot and NVDA extending its five-day slump, I expect a retest and slight break of today's $671.71 low (benzinga.com).

Nvidia's CEO resignation remains an active overhang ahead of Tuesday's earnings, and the stock has already lost 13.8% over five days (finance.yahoo.com). At $160.79 it is only about 1.5% above its $158.39 session low, so continued semiconductor liquidation makes a marginally lower close more likely than a sustained rebound.

DIA is down just 0.09% versus QQQ's 1.68% decline, consistent with reports that value-oriented segments are showing stronger relative performance (finance.yahoo.com). I expect defensive rotation to produce a modest afternoon grind back above the $522.47 previous close, although the broader risk-off tape keeps conviction low.
